PROTOTYPE

ABOUT GEAR-XR

Making brain data
easier to explore.

We’re a student team building interactive 3D brain atlases to explore brain anatomy and gene-expression data.

GEAR-XR connects brain anatomy with sourced gene-expression measurements, helping people explore regions and inspect the evidence behind what they see.

Explore the prototype ↗

OUR GOAL

A clearer connection between
brain regions and gene expression.

Our long-term goal is an anatomically grounded human 3D brain atlas for exploring how autism-associated genes are expressed across brain regions during postnatal development.

We’re also developing a mouse-atlas viewer as a starting point for exploring research datasets in 3D. We want to build this with researchers’ feedback on anatomy, data mapping and usability.

Where we are todayOur current expression datasets are adult reference measurements. Childhood developmental mapping is a future goal, not a completed capability.
